NTS Stainless Steel Fabrication products are custom-engineered solutions designed to meet the specific requirements of professional kitchens, restaurants, hotels, and food processing facilities. These made-to-order products combine superior craftsmanship with premium food-grade stainless steel to deliver equipment that perfectly fits your space and operational needs. Each fabrication project undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure precise dimensions, flawless welding, and impeccable finishing that meets international food safety standards. Our experienced fabricators work closely with clients to transform concepts into functional, durable equipment that enhances workflow efficiency and maintains the highest hygiene standards. The use of grade 304 stainless steel ensures exceptional corrosion resistance, easy cleaning, and long-lasting performance in demanding commercial environments. From custom work tables to specialized sinks, exhaust hoods, and storage solutions, every product is tailored to exact specifications while maintaining structural integrity and aesthetic appeal. Our work tables feature a knock-down design for easy transportation and installation, reducing shipping costs and simplifying on-site assembly. The modular design approach allows for future modifications and expansions, protecting your investment as your business grows. All fabricated products feature smooth, crevice-free surfaces that prevent bacterial growth and facilitate thorough sanitization.

  • Material: Food-grade stainless steel 304 (SS304) construction
  • Thickness: Various gauges available (1.0mm - 2.0mm standard)
  • Finish: Brushed or polished finish options
  • Welding: TIG welded joints with smooth finishing
  • Support: Reinforced frames and adjustable legs
  • Assembly: Knock-down design available for work tables
  • Customization: Fully customizable dimensions and configurations
  • Accessories: Optional backsplashes, undershelves, and drawers
  • Load Capacity: Engineered to support heavy commercial use
  • Compliance: Meets NSF and food safety standards
